fields.features_heading: What the App Carries From Quote to Payment
fields.features_subheading: Quotes and invoices live in different systems. The app Emergent builds moves each deal between them.
fields.feature_1:
One deal record from CRM to ledger

The app reads each accepted quote from your CRM and writes the order and invoice to QuickBooks or Xero through their APIs. The lines your customer accepted are the lines billed.
fields.feature_2:
Handoff rules written as sentences

Describe each handoff the way you would brief a new ops hire: when a quote is accepted, open the order; when it ships, draft the invoice. Emergent builds the logic from that.
fields.feature_3:
Stalled deals go to a named owner

An order with no invoice after 3 days goes to the billing lead you name, by Slack or email. A reminder follows the next morning, and an escalation if it still sits there.
fields.feature_4:
Acceptance signed on the quote page

Your customer opens the quote in the app and signs it there. The app records the signer's name and the time, then opens the order from the signed quote, nothing retyped.
fields.feature_5:
Stage dates in a database you own

The date each deal reaches a stage lands in a database you own. The dashboard reads from it, and finance can query the same rows when a deal needs explaining at quarter close.
fields.feature_6:
The code goes to your GitHub

Export the full code of the app to your GitHub repository on paid plans. Anyone on your team can read the invoice rules line by line and add any field your ledger needs.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Places a Deal Changes Hands
fields.tab_content_1:
From accepted quote to order SO-4127

Harlow Creek Brewing accepts quote Q-4127 from Corbel Instruments for $18,400.00: an analyzer at $15,600.00 and installation at $2,800.00. The app opens sales order SO-4127 with the same two lines and marks the HubSpot deal Closed Won. Ops lead Renata Okafor gets a task to schedule the install.
fields.tab_content_2:
The invoice runs $350 over its quote

Order SO-4133 ships to Dunmore Dental, and its invoice draft totals $9,850.00 against an accepted quote of $9,500.00: a $350.00 freight line was added. Your rule holds any invoice that differs from its quote. Billing lead Callum Lindqvist gets a direct message to approve or remove the line before it posts to QuickBooks.
fields.tab_content_3:
Renewal R-2207, drafted 60 days before it is due

Orrin Valley Clinics' service plan ends January 31. On December 2, 60 days before, the app drafts renewal quote R-2207 with the same three lines at this year's prices: $13,230.00, against $12,600.00 last term. Account owner Mei Sasaki gets the draft to review and send.
fields.tab_content_4:
Which handoff costs 9 of 47 days

Corbel's cycle dashboard averages 47 days between a quote going out and the cash arriving, over the last 90 days. Acceptance takes 6 days, the order 1, the invoice 9, and payment 31. Order to invoice runs 9 days against a 3-day target. The dashboard flags it in red as the first handoff to fix.

fields.howto_title: How to Automate Quote to Cash
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to map your deal handoffs and build quote to cash automation with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Name an owner for every exception
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Describe the app in a prompt
fields.howto_step_1_des: Take the 10 most recent deals you won and note four dates for each: quote sent, quote accepted, order opened, and invoice sent. The gaps between those dates show which handoff costs the most days, and that handoff is where the app starts.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write down where each record lives today: quotes in the CRM, orders in a spreadsheet or the ERP, and invoices in the accounting system. The app connects to each one through its API. Name the exact tools you use.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide who hears about each exception: the billing lead for an invoice that no longer matches the quote, the account owner for a renewal. Name one person, not a team inbox, and say whether they get a Slack message or an email.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Open Emergent and describe the flow in plain English, with the stage names your team already uses and the 3-day target for order to invoice. Emergent builds the app and the cycle dashboard from that prompt.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Connect the CRM and the ledger
fields.howto_step_5_des: Connect your CRM and accounting system, then map the fields: quote number to order reference, quote line to invoice line, payment terms to due date. Check one record in each system before the app starts writing to them.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Run one won deal through the app
fields.howto_step_6_des: Take one deal your team closed last month and run it through the app end to end. Compare the order and the invoice it creates with the ones your team made by hand, line by line, before going live.
fields.howto_step_7_des: When a handoff needs a new rule, such as a second approver for invoices over $25,000, describe it in a new prompt. Emergent changes the app, and the dashboard shows whether that stage got any faster.

faq_plan.q: What is quote to cash automation?
faq_plan.a: Quote to cash automation is software that carries a deal through each stage after pricing without anyone retyping it. The accepted quote becomes an order, the order becomes an invoice, and the payment closes the record. Zuora describes quote to cash as the stretch between the initial customer quote and the actual cash collected, covering quotes, orders, and invoices.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up quote to cash automation?
faq_plan.a: Start with one handoff, such as accepted quote to sales order, and describe it in a prompt to Emergent's AI automation builder. Emergent builds the app and its database, and the app connects to your CRM and accounting system through their APIs. Test it on one real deal, then add the next stage.

faq_plan.q: Which steps does quote to cash automation cover after the customer accepts?
faq_plan.a: It covers the seven that follow the quote. Conga lists 10 quote-to-cash steps: configuration, pricing, quoting, contract creation, contract negotiation, contract execution, order fulfillment, billing, revenue recognition, and renewal. The first three happen before acceptance and belong to the quote itself; the app takes over at the signed contract and runs through to renewal.

faq_plan.q: Does quote to cash automation start when the deal is won or when the quote goes out?
faq_plan.a: It starts when the quote goes out. Zuora draws the line this way: order-to-cash traditionally begins only after a contract is signed, while quote to cash moves the starting line upstream to include quoting. The work before the first quote, like lead follow-up, belongs to sales automation.

faq_plan.q: What data should quote to cash automation copy onto the invoice?
faq_plan.a: Every line on the accepted quote should reach the invoice unchanged, prices and discounts included, along with the payment terms. Add the customer's PO number if they gave one. Keep the quote number on the invoice as a reference, and anyone can trace a billed line back to what the customer accepted.

faq_plan.q: How should quote to cash automation handle a change after the customer accepts?
faq_plan.a: Treat the change as a new version of the quote, not an edit to the order. Have the customer accept the revised quote, then let the app update the order and the invoice from that version. Every invoice then traces back to terms the customer agreed to. With Emergent, every version sits in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Can one tool run quote to cash automation and marketing workflows?
faq_plan.a: Yes, with a builder that makes whole apps, not single connectors. In Emergent, each workflow starts as a plain-English prompt. A finance team's quote to cash app and a marketing team's seo automation can come from the same builder, each with its own data and its own owner.

faq_plan.q: How do I measure quote-to-cash automation results?
faq_plan.a: Track the days between stages, not only the total: quote sent to accepted, accepted to order, order to invoice, and invoice to paid. Measure those 4 gaps for a month before the app goes live, then compare them a month after. The gap that shrinks least is the next one to rework.

faq_plan.q: When should quote to cash automation draft a renewal quote?
faq_plan.a: Set it 60 days before the term ends for an annual plan with one approver, and 90 days for a customer whose purchasing team reviews every renewal. Conga lists renewal as the last of its 10 quote-to-cash steps, and the app starts it as a fresh quote with last term's lines.

faq_plan.q: What happens before a deal reaches quote to cash automation?
faq_plan.a: A lead becomes a qualified opportunity, and the opportunity gets a price. Lead capture and nurture emails belong to a marketing automation workflow, and quote to cash starts once a rep sends the first quote. Pass the contact and the deal amount into that quote, and nobody retypes them at the start.
